mono-0702.d: Two overlapping primary forms, reduced to pure geometry. The kind of print that ages well.

mono-0711.d: Crowded skyline of solid towers with grids of windows. Reads like a blueprint from across the room.

mono-0712.d: Open concentric pentagons, twisting slowly inward. Geometry class, but good.

mono-0719.d: Stippled grain cloud, hand-set dots gathering into separate masses, thick as static. A little retro, a little op-art.

mono-0742.d: Three overlapping primary forms, reduced to pure geometry. Minimal, but it holds the eye.

mono-0746.d: One-point perspective corridor, frames receding deep into the distance, rays packed tight. Grid discipline, worn casually.

mono-0754.d: Dot-matrix ring on a chunky LED grid. A little retro, a little op-art.

mono-0774.d: Dot-matrix diamond on a chunky LED grid. Printer's-proof texture, on purpose.

mono-0776.d: Cantilevered stack of concrete slabs, a few poured solid. Concrete energy without the weight.

mono-0790.d: Two families of sine waves crossing into a moiré. Calm, rhythmic, slightly restless.

mono-0792.d: Dense concentric heptagons, twisting slowly inward. Balanced enough to calm a busy outfit.

mono-0794.d: Dot-matrix ring on a chunky LED grid. The dots are the point.
